ideas.children_he: הָעָם מְבַקֵּשׁ אֱלוֹהִים וְעוֹשֶׂה עֵגֶל — הַסִּפּוּר מַזְמִין אוֹתָנוּ לַחֲשֹׁב עַל בְּחִירָה נְכוֹנָה, עַל אַחֲרָיוּת וְעַל הַיְּכֹלֶת לְתַקֵּן טָעוּיוֹת.
ideas.children_en: The people fear Moses is delayed, ask Aaron for a god to lead them, and bring their gold jewelry. Aaron makes a golden calf, and the people proclaim it as the god who brought them from Egypt. This story invites us to think about making choices, taking responsibility, and correcting mistakes.

ideas.children_he: הָעָם חוֹגֵג לִפְנֵי הָעֵגֶל — הַסִּפּוּר מַזְמִין אוֹתָנוּ לַחֲשֹׁב עַל בְּחִירָה נְכוֹנָה, עַל אַחֲרָיוּת וְעַל הַיְּכֹלֶת לְתַקֵּן טָעוּיוֹת.
ideas.children_en: Aaron builds an altar before the calf and announces a festival. The next day the people offer sacrifices, eat and drink, and rise for wild celebration. This story invites us to think about making choices, taking responsibility, and correcting mistakes.

ideas.children_he: ה׳ מוֹדִיעַ לְמֹשֶׁה עַל הַחֵטְא — הַסִּפּוּר מַזְמִין אוֹתָנוּ לַחֲשֹׁב עַל בְּחִירָה נְכוֹנָה, עַל אַחֲרָיוּת וְעַל הַיְּכֹלֶת לְתַקֵּן טָעוּיוֹת.
ideas.children_en: God tells Moses to go down from the mountain because the people have corrupted their way and made a molten calf. He calls them stiff-necked and announces His anger. This story invites us to think about making choices, taking responsibility, and correcting mistakes.

ideas.children_he: מֹשֶׁה מִתְפַּלֵל עַל הָעָם — הַסִּפּוּר מַזְמִין אוֹתָנוּ לַחֲשֹׁב עַל בְּחִירָה נְכוֹנָה, עַל אַחֲרָיוּת וְעַל הַיְּכֹלֶת לְתַקֵּן טָעוּיוֹת.
ideas.children_en: Moses pleads with God not to destroy the people, recalls the Exodus and the concern for God’s reputation among Egypt, and invokes the promise to the ancestors. God relents from the threatened disaster. This story invites us to think about making choices, taking responsibility, and correcting mistakes.

ideas.children_he: מֹשֶׁה יוֹרֵד עִם לוּחוֹת הַבְּרִית — הַסִּפּוּר מַזְמִין אוֹתָנוּ לַחֲשֹׁב עַל בְּחִירָה נְכוֹנָה, עַל אַחֲרָיוּת וְעַל הַיְּכֹלֶת לְתַקֵּן טָעוּיוֹת.
ideas.children_en: Moses descends from the mountain carrying the two tablets of testimony, written by God. Joshua hears a sound from the camp, while Moses recognizes it as celebration rather than war. This story invites us to think about making choices, taking responsibility, and correcting mistakes.

ideas.children_he: מֹשֶׁה שׁוֹבֵר אֶת הַלּוּחוֹת וּמַשְׁמִיד אֶת הָעֵגֶל — הַסִּפּוּר מַזְמִין אוֹתָנוּ לַחֲשֹׁב עַל בְּחִירָה נְכוֹנָה, עַל אַחֲרָיוּת וְעַל הַיְּכֹלֶת לְתַקֵּן טָעוּיוֹת.
ideas.children_en: Moses sees the calf and the dancing, becomes angry, and breaks the tablets at the foot of the mountain. He burns and grinds the calf, scatters its powder in water, and makes the Israelites drink it. This story invites us to think about making choices, taking responsibility, and correcting mistakes.

ideas.children_he: אַהֲרוֹן מְתְרֵץ אֶת מַעֲשָׂיו — הַסִּפּוּר מַזְמִין אוֹתָנוּ לַחֲשֹׁב עַל בְּחִירָה נְכוֹנָה, עַל אַחֲרָיוּת וְעַל הַיְּכֹלֶת לְתַקֵּן טָעוּיוֹת.
ideas.children_en: Moses asks Aaron how he brought such great sin upon the people. Aaron blames the people’s inclination toward evil and claims that after they brought gold and he threw it into the fire, the calf simply emerged. This story invites us to think about making choices, taking responsibility, and correcting mistakes.

ideas.children_he: בְּנֵי לֵוִי עוֹמְדִים לְצַד ה׳ — הַסִּפּוּר מַזְמִין אוֹתָנוּ לַחֲשֹׁב עַל בְּחִירָה נְכוֹנָה, עַל אַחֲרָיוּת וְעַל הַיְּכֹלֶת לְתַקֵּן טָעוּיוֹת.
ideas.children_en: Moses sees that the people are unrestrained and disgraced, calls for those who stand with the Lord, and the Levites gather to him. They carry out Moses’ command, many offenders fall, and Moses charges the Levites with devotion and blesses them. This story invites us to think about making choices, taking responsibility, and correcting mistakes.

ideas.children_he: מֹשֶׁה מְבַקֵּשׁ כַּפָּרָה עַל הָעָם — הַסִּפּוּר מַזְמִין אוֹתָנוּ לַחֲשֹׁב עַל בְּחִירָה נְכוֹנָה, עַל אַחֲרָיוּת וְעַל הַיְּכֹלֶת לְתַקֵּן טָעוּיוֹת.
ideas.children_en: The next day Moses tells the people that they have committed a great sin and goes up again to God to seek atonement for them. This story invites us to think about making choices, taking responsibility, and correcting mistakes.

ideas.children_he: מֹשֶׁה מִתְוַודֶּה וּמְבַקֵּשׁ רַחֲמִים — הַסִּפּוּר מַזְמִין אוֹתָנוּ לַחֲשֹׁב עַל בְּחִירָה נְכוֹנָה, עַל אַחֲרָיוּת וְעַל הַיְּכֹלֶת לְתַקֵּן טָעוּיוֹת.
ideas.children_en: Moses returns to the Lord, confesses the people’s great sin, and asks for forgiveness, offering to be erased from God’s book if necessary. This story invites us to think about making choices, taking responsibility, and correcting mistakes.

ideas.children_he: ה׳ מֵשִׁיב וּמִמֶּנָּה הַנְהָגָה — הַסִּפּוּר מַזְמִין אוֹתָנוּ לַחֲשֹׁב עַל בְּחִירָה נְכוֹנָה, עַל אַחֲרָיוּת וְעַל הַיְּכֹלֶת לְתַקֵּן טָעוּיוֹת.
ideas.children_en: God answers that only the sinner will be erased from His book, and commands Moses to lead the people onward with an angel going before them; their sin will later be remembered. This story invites us to think about making choices, taking responsibility, and correcting mistakes.

ideas.children_he: ה׳ מַעֲנִישׁ עַל חֵטְא הָעֵגֶל — הַסִּפּוּר מַזְמִין אוֹתָנוּ לַחֲשֹׁב עַל בְּחִירָה נְכוֹנָה, עַל אַחֲרָיוּת וְעַל הַיְּכֹלֶת לְתַקֵּן טָעוּיוֹת.
ideas.children_en: The Lord strikes the people with a plague because they made the golden calf, which Aaron had fashioned. This story invites us to think about making choices, taking responsibility, and correcting mistakes.
